paragraphs.text: Cards from Aether Revolt compared to cards from earlier sets .
Disallow is strictly better than Voidslime and Cancel .
Druid of the Cowl is strictly better than Orochi Sustainer and Wirewood Elf .
Hungry Flames is strictly better than Lunge .
Ice Over is strictly better than Coma Veil , Dehydration , Glimmerdust Nap , Inertia Bubble , Merseine , Paralyzing Grasp and Spectral Prison .
Lathnu Sailback is strictly better than Fire Elemental .
Outland Boar is strictly better than Rhox Brute .
Reverse Engineer is strictly better than Tezzeret's Ambition .
Inspiring Roar is a colorshifted version of Titania's Boon (green to white).
